JW-MC30G Series
Main property
Input voltage：DC5V
Operating temperature：-20℃ ~ 60℃
Outer shell：Fanless design
MTBF：100000 hours
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
The optical fiber transceiver realizes the conversion between Ethernet twisted pair and Ethernet optical signal, and the maximum network transmission distance can be increased to more than 100km. The product series supports link fault alarm, wide operating temperature range, port and power surge protection, and meets deployment requirements in outdoor
